tei:div.tei:p: —— 〉spyobs ma ha a nyi yo ga'i lugs dran ོgas rig pa'i bskyed rim na ublo 'das chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi klong:ma 'gags 'od gsal dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs dal:rig stong khyab brdal che mchog gnam zhal dbyings:ye shes rang mdangs dpal chen yongs rdzogs sku:shes rab phyag rgya bdun brgya nyer lnga po:ma 'dres du ma rang gsal tshul du shar:spros bral dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang tshogs yul yid chos rang gsal ting 'dzin skyongs:snang srid gzhir bzhengs lta ba gzigs bstod nas:rtsol sgrubs mi dmigs rig pa sor bzhag ngang oṃ badzra tsarnya sarba duṣṭan da ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa:ye rdzogs rin ma bor ba gang shar 'dzan med gzhi grol skyongs gnad kyi khams gsum ka nas dag don gnyas lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yā sngags kyi mchod ci bstod pa ni hū hrī:nga bdag zil gnon rig stong he ru ga:che mchog yab yum bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dal:ngo bo gcig la rnam rol bsam mtha' yas:zhi dang khro tshul ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod:'di bzung gdod ma'i sku gsum mngon gyur bar ma rig gnyis snang bag nyal dri ma

kun rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag sang nas: bum sku che mchog dbang phyug dpal thob shog: de ltar don gyi sgrub pa 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug spyod yul yin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin gan snyirtis bkra shis lha reg rin chen gnyis pa'i skyesabacas nan du bskul ngor khrag 'thung nus ldan dpa' bos spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam/

7༷ bskal ba lcags sbrul lo'i zla 10tshes 10kyis nub mor/nyams 'od gsal dang 'dres pa'i snang char/ rang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar 'phur te yul mang /rnozlo nas/mchod rten bde byed ma hā bha la zhes bya ba'i drung du gnas tshe/bum sgo'i 'ja' 'od kyi klong na mkha' 'gro ma rus rgyan dar sna nyi zla'i mdzes pa gcig la/ḍazhi phyogs mdog mjes pa bzhis gus 'dud kyi zhe sa chen po phul 'dug pa la/bdag gis 'di ci yin bsnyams tshe stong pa'i dbyings las 'di skad grags byung ngo rang byung mchod rten ma hā bha la'i drung/phyi ltar mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che/nang ltar gsang ba ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ gsang ltar kun dga' smon lam zhes su grags/ rigs bzhi'i ḍakki bde ba'i dpal du shar/snyan rgyud rin chen mdzod kyi rten 'brel lags/zhes pa'i dus gang dkar nag gnyis dang ling ga pho mo bzhis du tra mgo bo gsum pa mdog thal skya'i mdog can zhig 'dor byung ba la/ḍakri ma yis gri khug tshad pas rnam shes dbyings la spar/khog pa kha phyes nas zhing lpags brdal khyab tu bkod pa la/ḍakki

rigs bzhis las gnyer byas te tsitta rang byung kun gyi bcud/ che mchog yon tan mnyes pa'i rdzas/ dkyil 'khor dbus su bkod pa ni/ o rgyan rang byung pho brang ngo/ mkhris pa chab kyi dngas ma ste/ yang dag thugs mchog mnyes pa'i rdzas/ da la'i shar du bkram pa ni/ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod lags/ mchin pa ro bcud ldan pa ste/ 'jam dpal sku yi dgyes bskyed rdzas/ dkyil 'khor lho ru bzhag pa ni/ sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod yin/ khrag dang 'brel ba'i glo ba ni/ padma gsung mchog mnyes pa'i rdzas/ da la'i nub tu bshams pa ni/ dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod mchog srog rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa dkar nag phrin las phur pa dgyes bskyed rdzas/ dkyil 'khor byang du bkod pa ni/ laṅga brtsegs pa'i dur khrod lags/ rakta 'khyil ba'i mtsher ba ni/ ma mo rbod gtong dgyes pa'i sprin/ shar lho'i mtshams su bkod pa ni/ dga' mar rol ba'i dur khrod yin/ bde skyongasako ro tsa nas bkang/ rig 'dzin slob dpon mnyes pa'i rdzas/ lho nub thig ler bkod pa ni/ bde byed brtsegs pa'i dur khrod yin/ mkhal ma g.yas kyi bkod pa ni/ 'jig rten

53 mchod bstod dgyes pa'i rdzas/ nub byang mtshams su bkod pa ni/ rab 'jigs rngams pa'i dur khrod lags/ mkhal ma g.yon gyi dam rdzas ni/ dmod pa drag byedapa bskang ba'i sprin/ byang shar gnas su mtshams pa ni/ 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod yin/ pho rgang nya bzhi'i rgyus pa ni/ dpal gyi bka' sdod dgyes bskyed rdzas/bar khyams yongs la bkram pa ni/ rol pa chen po'i dur khrod lags/ rtsib mas drwa ba mig mang ris/ ba su ta yis gtor thag dang/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad bzhugs pa'i gnas/ 'khrul 'khor chos nyid 'khor lor sbyor/ mig ni mnyes pa'i ku mu ta/ dri chen bdug pa bla na med/ drod kyi 'khor lo a lo ke/ dri chu chab kyi bkod par shar/ srid pa'i pho bsgos zhal zas dang / 'dod yon ro mnyam bkod pa ni/ dpal dgu dgyes pa'i rdzas su sprin/ gtor gdan rū tra'i phung po la/ thog phub mgo sgra'i bla brer snang / de nas las kyi dbang mo ches/ thod rnga g.yer phreng smra dang bcas/ gang rnams rnge'u chung tir ltar brdung / laṅgas bro gar stobs las bsgyur/ ḍakkis bsad gla rba gling 'bud/ pho rgyud

rnams kyis g.yab dar 'phen/ mo rgyud rnams kyi mda' dar bsor/ sman srung yongs kyis rtog pa brjod/ rig 'dzin rnams kyis byin rlabs 'bebs/ yi dam lha tshogs sprin ltar gtibs/ pho nya dam can rlung ltar 'tshubs/ kun gyis mgrin gcig 'di skad brjod/ e: mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsang mdzod dpal/ che mchog dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha/ dbyer med chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ ngo bo zhi zhing rang bzhin khro/ thugs rje dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsang / ma brtsal rdzogs ldan rang byung shar/ marmesaza/sku 1padzeca /rgya/ nasgrosanang sku yi rnal 'byar/ hūṃ hūṃ/ ru lu tshangs ba'i 'dren stangs kyis/ stong khams rta yi glu ru len/thal 'byin dgongs pas gzer rgyas 'debs/ bde rol ma mo'i dgongs klong nas/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyis 'dzab/ longs sku ye shes snyoms pa'i 'dzab/ sprul sku thugs rje bskul ba'i 'dzab/ yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'dzab/ phrin las gol sa bcad pa'i 'dzab/ hūṃ ha he phaṭa dza bhyo/ zhes pa'i chos can bcom pa'i gla/ chos nyid mnyam pa'i

ma brda ru sgrogs/79ri37 tshu ༅ma/ gsung gi rnal yor ro/hrīḥdagongs pa de bzhin nyid du gnas/rnam rol ye shes khro la gas/du tra kun gyi gshed po dī /sdog pa he ru ga'i mi spyod/'jigs lta zil gnon 4:glu len/mi 'gyur lta ba'i gzer chen gyis/kun bzang che mchog yon ma dang /rgyud dang sgrub sde yongs rdzogs kyi/spyi dpal he ru mngon du 'gyur/me ri 'bar bar btsan sa zin/ zaho rwathachuzacha mishā thugasakya rnal yor ro/trī:dbang bskur rgyal po bla na med/ye shesakun gyi gsang ba mchog/de bzhin nyid ni rigs kyi spyi/lhan skyes ye shes sangs rgyas zhal/gang shar rang grol rdo rje'i gsungs/kun khyab 'gyur med thugs kyi dpal/rgyal thabs spyi blugs don gyi dbang /bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa sogs/gcig rdzogs bu la dgongs pa'i sbyin/brda thabasatshigagi sprosapa bral/don dma'agyur med mngonagyur shogayospri sidri ka wā co ma 'jutsho7shā1 gabasgolayor ro/hri dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyal po ni/spri dang khyad par lhag pa'o/mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig lta ba'i gnad/sgom pa'i

dam tshig sku gsung thugs/ spyod pa'i dam tshig rgyun gyi bcu/ 'bras bu spang thob bral ba'o/ za ri me long brda dbang snying gar reg/ sku 'od 'dres pa mgrin par thim/ thams cad mi gnas spyi bor son/ rnam kun mchog ldan chos kyi dbyings/ kun khyab rig par a la la/ phe dza trīng ya sa twa bam̐/ ces gto rgya sad la sko mo'i rnal 'byer du ldang ngo/gsung gi bka' bab rgyamatsho zungs/ thugs kyi bka' bab shā ra gsum/ phrin las bka' babamasgo bzhi/ sku la bab pa6me gcig yon tan mdzod 'changabadzra zungs/ ma mo bde spyodasirnyi'abod/ slob dpon spyi 'dusartog pamimatshan/mchod bstod las bsngagasas gsum/ drag sngags rol ba rgyal gyiming / chos skyongs bka' babab ste/ rjes thob mkha' 'gro'i brda ru bstan/nus na rdo rjesaphab pa'o/ sabo ma le/
dpa dag snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo snyan brgyud rin po che'i mdzod lasaḥdapal chen stobs ldan nag po'i rtsa sgrub me rlung 'khyil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

sgo nga na mo gu ru yeḥ rten stobasamatshag khro po 'dus pa'i sprin gdug pa tshar gcod che ba'i rgyal shin tu rngams brjed bzod dka'i was drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal loḥnarsābasgrub pa'i ga rdo byeng zhes shan tu zab pa'i gab tig bstan phun tshogs dben pa'i gnas mtshog sa sgrub pa'i sta gon lasagazhung bsreng phrin la stobs kyi lha gsal ba sgo gsum ma bcos rig par dril gang shar rang grol kho na 'oḥ eḥ gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du phyi nang snod bcud gdos mtshan rnam par dag ye shes 'od snang thod mkhar rngams brjid slongaX bde stong 'ub chub rakta 'khrul ba'i nang tshogs yul rnam dag rin chen khri rkang steng thabs shes zhal sbyor nyi ma zla ba'i khar rtog bcas rū tra pho mo bsgol ba'i khriraX rig pa hūṃ las bskyed pa'i he ru ga stobasaldan nag po dbu gsum phyag drug ldan rngams brjid khro gtum mthing nag 'bar ba'i skuḥ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan dgu bsgradaX smar smin me 'bar shangs nas dug rlang 'phyoḥ g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad citta 'dzinaḥ g.yon rnams bhan dmar glu brgyad snying phyung bsdams sdang zhen ma rig 'khrul ba dbyings su

sgo2 sgrolaX tshogs yul rnam dag dur khrod dpal chas brgyanaḥ zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa'i bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo ni gzugs je dro mkhar 'degs 'dod khams gnon dang sbyor ma rig gsum bsreg me lnga'i klong na 'gyings che btsan stobs rtsal srid na mtshungs dpe bral de yi bka' 'khor ye shes sgyu 'phrul niḥ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'chi bdag gshin rje nag bgegs tshogs 'thar gtub spu gri thod dbyug 'dzinaḥ mnyes bskyed btsun mo mthing gsal khro 'dzum sgeg phyag g.yas spu gri g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzinaX mu steg kā la yaka skrug nag khro dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭaṃ tri shul gzir bdud po me yi kha rlangs mthing nag rngams skye 'chir dbang za khram shing bdud zhags bsdams ༷ mi sdug rngams brjed bdud mo khrag 'dzag nag srid pa bde sbyor khram bam thod rlon 'chang lha chen ma hā de wa sku mdog dkar phyag g.yas ba dan g.yon pas shel gri phyar srin po gsod byed ser nag rngams pa'i zhal rgyud lnga dbyings sgrol gri gug thod khrag 'dzinaX dgyes bskyed srin mo

gsod byed chen mo mthing nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri dang thod rlon 'changaX khyab mjug chen po smug nag 'bar ba'i zhal g.yas kyi khram shing g.yon phyag dgra stu phyar du tra thar ba nag po khro 'dzum sgegaX mchod gtor g.yas la thun gtor g.yon pas btegasaḥ gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po sku mdog sngo phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas dar nag sdebasaḥ sha za ral gcig khro zhing gtum pa'i zhalaḥ mthing gsal dar nag g.yas la lngags rlon g.yonaḥ li byin har legs har dkar bzhad pa'i nyamasaḥ gcod byed shel gri dang ni ba dan phyaraX btsan rje yab shud dmar po glog ltar 'byug rngams pa'i mdung dmar dang ni gri ring thogs dmu dzobatsan po dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i sku g.yas phyag g.yab dar g.yon pa'i zhags pa 'dzinaḥ dam can rdor legs dkar dmar 'dzum pa'i zhalaḥ dar dkar dar dmar dpa' bo'i phyag char bsnams 'gong po khu le ser skya 'jigs rngams lnganaX lag dgu 'gyed cing gdug pa'i phrin las byedaḥ kla rgyal gzhon rgo mthing gsal 'dzum nyams rgyasaḥ phyag g.yas bum pa g.yon pas rus sbal 'dzinaX

sgo drag sngags dmod pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams ma 'dres mkha' la gza' skar bkra bzhin gsal don dam lta ba dag pa'i ye shes paḥ gdos por ma grus rdongs ma'i rang bzhin sgomaḥ hū dbus mtha' med pa chos dbyings e klong nas rig stong mnyam nyid dmod pa drag sngags lha ye shes gsal sgor spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang nas rab bzhugs shingaḥ 'du 'bral med pa'i tshul du phyag bgyi'oX phyag rgya gar dang phyi nang mchod pa dngaḥ sbyor sgrol gtor ma rakta'i mchod pa dngaX dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags naḥ gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyangaḥ 'khor 'das chos skur mthong ba'i dngos grub stsolaX rig pa srog tu shar ba'i gzungs thag gisaḥ dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa'i 'dzab rgyun bskyangs dgongs pa de bzhin nyid slong mngon gyur nasaḥ 'dza ra 'das spyi dpal stobs ldan lhun grub ngangaḥ phag badzra sarba du khya e dza bhyo hūṃ phaṭaX bzlas pa dbugs kyi rta la bskyod 'phro 'du phrin las 'dzab rgyun bskyangs dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer du

gdab rtogs pa' yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas don gnyis lhun grub ze tshom med sa ma pāḥ rgya rgya rgya / trī: chos nyid mi 'gyur stobs ldan nag po'i zhal 'dzadar 'das 'ub chub 'byung ba lnga yi bdagaḥ ye shes sgog shar bka' nyan bco brgyad steḥ drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod don dam mngon gyur rnal 'byer sgrub pa pos gnas snang gzugs sku gnyis 1nga bskyed rdzogs bsring go myong rtogs pas bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor brtsonaḥ chos zad blo bral he ru ka dpal zhalaḥ mngon gyur thog ma'i grol par byang chub shog dge bsngo smon lam shisapa brjod mtha' bral klong yangs dgongs bskyongs des na stobs ldan drag sngags lha mngon sum 'grub par the mo tshomaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i mdzodaḥ ye shes gsang brda klong nas mjal sred len bral ba'i ri mo las nges gsang don gyi char ba phab bug rdol ma yanapadma lnga 'di yi sgod dang ldan pa'o mchog dang me rib rab 'bring tha rjes ma phrin lasamathar phyin dpalaḥ ḍazhi'i lung las gsal ba'oḥ sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥlhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang bla mamathar phyin rdo rjes/ rin po che'i mchong dmar byur dkar thabs shes mtshon pa'i rten dang g.yu byang mkha' 'gro'i gsang rten bkra shis lha reg sogs kyi skyes
——1༷ bzang po du ma dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor/bdag 'dra mo rgyan mkha' klong yang pa rtsal gyis dag par phab pa sarba maṅga lo/
—11 dag snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo snyan brgyud rin po che'i mdzod lasaḥ bder 'dus bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub skoraḥ don dam rtags kyi sgrub ye shes snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

——3 na mo gu ru kro ta rā dza ya 〉nadzas( kun mkhyen kun gzigasaye shesaphung po can don dam ye shes snying po la phyag la'iḥskal ldan lhan skyes gzhi rgyud rtogs pa'i phyaraḥrang byung don gyi sgrub pa 'dir brtson bya ma mā stor ba dngosagazhi rje kyi rim pa gsum dang po la yang rnam grangasarim bdun las thog mar skyabs 'gro ni na moḥbade btagags snying po rig pa byang chub sems tshom bu dgu rdzogs mnyam gnas chen po ni ye nas 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub gnyis med rang ngo rig pas skyabs su mchiḥganyas pa sems bskyed na hoḥm rig gnyis 'ardzan sems kyi dbang gyur bas sku dang ye shes nang dbyings la gab ste phyi gdangs 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i 'khor lor 'phyanaḥrang rig lta ba'i thal 'byin sems bskyed do gsum pa tshogs bsagasani na mo dbyings rig zung 'jug tshom bu dgu rdzogs dal rang byung rang ngo rig pas phyag 'tshal loḥ'akhor 'das ma spangs gzhi rdzogs mchod pa 'bul nyon shes dri ma gzung 'dzin bag chags bshags thams cad dag mnyam klong la rjes yi rang ka dag zang thal chos 'khor bsgor bar bskalaḥdus gsum 'pho 'byur bral bar

jorta bzhugs gsol 'debs dge kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngoḥ nang dbyings dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs mngon gyur shog bzhi pa bka' bsgo niḥhū /des nas rnam dag thig le nyag gcig la bgegs gdon mtshan ma'i spros pa ka dag kyang tha snyad rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi'i dbang gyur bdud 'dod lnga rang grol rgyu ma'i brngan gyis bskangs don dam ye stong 'khor lor mtshams bcad do hūhūṃ bisnan ta krita phaṭa phaṭaḥ lnga pa bsrung lor niḥhū dhi gzhes rmed nig mi bde ba chen po'i klong kun gzhi rnam rtog dri ma ka dag ngang ye shes lnga rdzogs gsang ba chen po ste 'di la bgegs gdon mtshan mas glags mi rted ཿdzñā na dhartu rakta rakta / drug pa byin 'beb niḥhū /hūḥ dbus mtha' rmed pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las bde gshegs zhi ba khrag 'thung tshom bu dgu ye shes gcig las rnam rol mtha' yas pa'i brtan g.yo phung khams sems rtog sna tshogs khamasaḥ dag smin rdzogs pa'i byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ gdod nas dag pa'i gnas lugs mngon gyur zhing ye shes dgu rdzogs gzigs pa'i dbang phyin phob sa ma

hā gu ru dhe wa ḍakki ni sarba kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra e a ra li trī hrī po pho ཿ a we sha ya a ā bdun pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa naḥ snyen ā (ཿ dbang po'i gsal sgor bkod pa'i 'dod yon sprinaḥ yul can rnam dag lha mo bsam yas pas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang phyir stobs zad med nam mkha' mdzod du phun tshogs gyuraX slo sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ trī 'iX oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūṃ hrī 'iḥ o ma hā ba lirnyi te dzwa ba lirnya ba la ba te gu hya hrī shwa sa ma ya hūṃ hrī 'iX oṃ ā nyuX ma hā sto dhi tsitta ga na gu hya na ma sarba hūṃ trī 'iḥs badzra asnyi pabye pukhye dhā pe a lo ke ghadhe nee widu shasta pū dza spra ra ṇa dzaḥ de ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'oḥs ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya de nas dngos gzha'i ram pa la rnam grangs bco lngas sgo nas bstan dang po ting 'dzan rnam gsum naḥ o chos rge mi 'gyur rdo rje yis 'chi ba ka dag dbyings su sbyangasaX longasasku bdochen rdo rje yisaḥ bar do 'od gsal lhun grub bsreḥ shāḥsprul sku chags bral rdo rje yis ste ba sprul pa'i smra ru sgodaḥ badzra sa mā dhi hūṃ gnyis pa lha bskyed ni ྅ skye 'gags med pa'i mkha' smong las bsted byed sa bon ྅ mthing sharaḥ de las ram̐ ye khaṃ spos
